incident.title: Server process exits unexpectedly every few minutes with "Unknown column 'createdAt'"
incident.description: Since the last deploy the rssmonster server process dies every few minutes and is restarted by the supervisor. Right before each exit the log shows an unhandled SequelizeDatabaseError: Unknown column 'createdAt'. It happens with no user request in flight, on a regular interval. The database was migrated forward from an older schema. Find the cause.
